findings.text: the default factory carries the whole repair, yet reverting that one line to get_graph_uri leaves all five tests in tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py passing while forcing the helper to return None fails two of them, so the suite does not pin the change this node exists to make.

an explicitly set NEO4J_URI is discarded inside a SLURM step, because the direct resolution replaces the profile URI before the environment escape hatch is consulted, while imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:433 records that hatch as always winning and the new precedence is documented nowhere (measured: with SLURM_JOB_ID and NEO4J_URI=bolt://example.invalid:1 set, the resolved address was still bolt://98dci4-gpu-0002:7687).
every exception out of resolve_location is swallowed into None, which silently restores the loopback endpoint this node repaired, and that branch carries no test.

the monkeypatch targets the client module, but imas_codex/graph/client.py:119 imports _resolve_compute_host from imas_codex.remote.locations inside the function, so line 69 is inert and only the patch on the line after it has effect.

justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's local-import and docstring idiom and carry no plan label, but imas_codex/graph/client.py:139-145 overrides an explicitly set NEO4J_URI that imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:433 documents as an escape hatch that always wins, and tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py:69 patches an attribute the code never reads.
